fields.Name: T190 - Identity and Access Left-Nav Section Switching
fields.Description: Exercises BaseAdminContainerComponent's dynamic section resolution + component caching + deep-link (?section=) switching between resource- and dashboard-backed sub-pages — the container mechanism itself, not any single section render.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and open the 'Identity & Access' area. It presents a left navigation with six sub-sections: Users, Roles, Apps, App Roles, Permissions, and API Keys. Click through several of them in turn (e.g. Users -> Roles -> App Roles -> API Keys) and verify each swaps the main content region to that section's distinct UI without leaving the Identity & Access container. Success is each left-nav item loading its own content area. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Identity & Access container shows a left navigation listing Users, Roles, Apps, App Roles, Permissions, and API Keys
Selecting different left-nav items swaps the main content region to distinctly different section UI each time
The active section is highlighted in the left nav and the container title/chrome stays consistent
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
